newsitem.title: CANADA: Tennis-Sampras withdraws from Montreal tennis.
newsitem.headline: Tennis-Sampras withdraws from Montreal tennis.

text.p: World No. 1 Pete Sampras has withdrawn from next week's du Maurier Open in Montreal due to an arm injury, tournament officials announced on Thursday.
Sampras, who won the Australian Open in January and Wimbledon earlier this month, aggravated the injury in practice, according to tournament organisers.

Sampras, who next month will be going for his third successive U.S. Open title, was to join six other top 10 players in Montreal -- Michael Chang, Goran Ivanisevic, Yevgeny Kafelnikov, Thomas Muster, Richard Krajicek and Thomas Enqvist.
